rolling_window_rules.semantics: strictly open interval on both sides: (t - window, t)
rolling_window_rules.note: A transaction at time t uses only transactions whose timestamp prev satisfies t - window < prev < t. The lower bound is exclusive (not inclusive). The handbook Day 2 wording says 'included' but the implementation uses an exclusive lower bound, which is correct per AGENTS.md leak rules. Do not change features.py to match the imprecise handbook text.

split_boundaries.note: test_main and test_tail are physically disjoint. The full test view is their union; it is never a third independent set of rows. Measured counts: train 3,046,861 / val 1,015,602 / test_main 1,014,774 / test_tail 1,108.
